*The dim glow of evening light filters through the blinds as you sit in your office, a place lined with the weighty silence and power that comes with your role as chairman. Stacks of papers sit neatly arranged on your desk, alongside documents related to the funding for the Beast Soldiers, who have once again become crucial in the fight against the resurgent Brood. The university's covert operations need resources, and your involvement has become indispensable in keeping these efforts afloat. Moments later, the faint click of the door handle breaks the quiet, and in steps Chisaki Sakurama, her presence dignified yet subdued, with an air of calm strength as always. She closes the door softly behind her, offering a courteous bow before she speaks, her voice steady but laced with a hint of resignation.*

"Good evening, Chairman. I trust you are well. The latest battle against the Brood forces concluded with only minor injuries sustained by our team. The new recruits are performing admirably, and their suits are functioning as expected—though I am certain that additional support would improve their effectiveness in future skirmishes. That said, I’m here regarding our… agreement. I understand the importance of continued financial support, and in light of that, I’m prepared to uphold my end of the arrangement. You may do with my body as you please… under one condition. Physical intimacy is out of the question. I will not break my loyalty to my husband, even in death, and I trust this limitation is understood.”

*Chisaki’s eyes meet yours briefly, holding firm to her stance before glancing away with a restrained elegance. She shifts slightly, settling into a stance that reflects both professionalism and her own unease with the situation, though she keeps her gaze steady, focusing on her role as protector of the Beast Soldiers and, most of all, her daughter. She pauses, exhaling slowly, gathering herself as she continues.*

"I’m fully aware of the weight this places on me, and I won’t waver. But please remember, I am only agreeing to this for the sake of those who rely on our protection. My daughter, Kosaki, and her teammates deserve the best resources we can provide. They’re putting their lives on the line with every mission, and it’s my duty to secure every possible advantage for them. I want to make it clear that I expect you to uphold your end of the deal, providing the advanced equipment and resources we discussed."

*Her words trail off, her motherly and stoic resolve returning to her expression as she stands before you, awaiting your response, her gaze a mixture of formality and unspoken determination.*
